user.title: Sleep score
user.description: Choose the entity that carries last night's sleep. Supported source: Life Dashboard (the "Last sleep asleep" sensor).

data_description.name: Used for the device and its entities, for example a person's name.
data_description.time_zone_entity: An entity that knows which time zone the phone is in, such as the iOS companion app's geocoded location sensor. Bedtimes are compared in the local time where you slept. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's time zone.
data_description.time_zone_attribute: Used if it holds a zone name like Europe/London; otherwise the entity's state is tried.

error.not_a_sleep_entity: This entity does not carry sleep data in a supported format.

abort.already_configured: This sleep entity is already set up.

data_description.time_zone_entity: An entity that knows which time zone the phone is in, such as the iOS companion app's geocoded location sensor. Bedtimes are compared in the local time where you slept. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's time zone.
data_description.time_zone_attribute: Used if it holds a zone name like Europe/London; otherwise the entity's state is tried.

formula.name: Formula constants (advanced)
formula.description: The defaults are model v5. Changing a value rescores every stored night.

data.duration_full_hours: Duration: hours asleep for full points
data.duration_coeff: Duration: points lost per squared hour short
data.bedtime_late_per_minute: Bedtime: points lost per minute later
data.bedtime_early_coeff: Bedtime: factor on the square root of minutes earlier
data.wakeup_points: Interruptions: points lost per extra wake-up
data.awake_points_per_minute: Interruptions: points lost per extra minute awake
data.wakeup_min_minutes: Interruptions: minutes awake that count as a wake-up
data.band_very_high: Band: lowest score for Very High

error.invalid_formula: One of the formula constants is outside its allowed range, or the band limits are not in rising order.

recalculate.name: Recalculate
recalculate.description: Scores every stored night again with the current constants.
